title: Modification to achieve transferor's tax objectives.
bodyText: To achieve the transferor's tax objectives, the court may modify the terms of a governing instrument in a manner that is not contrary to the transferor's probable intention. The court may provide that the modification has retroactive effect.
bodyHtml: [§560:2-806]  Modification to achieve transferor's tax objectives.  To achieve the transferor's tax objectives, the court may modify the terms of a governing instrument in a manner that is not contrary to the transferor's probable intention.  The court may provide that the modification has retroactive effect. [L 2023, c 158, pt of §4]
